typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT \'HDR\' AS HDR, REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATE,PREM_RATE_START_DT),101),\'/\',\'\') AS PREM_DATE,\'614DE1C9-63CF-41A1-81E1-1E357CECB4B6\' AS SERIAL#, \'GBD\' AS GBD, COUNT(*) AS COUNT,\'MSUP\' AS MSUP FROM [BOSS].[Letter].[Prem_Stage] GROUP BY PREM_RATE_START_DT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBHEADER
SRCOLEDBHEADER sink(input(
		CSCS_ID as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		ASM as string,
		DETAIL as string,
		CSPI_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CSCS_ID = GBD,
		GRGR_ID = {SERIAL#},
		SBSB_ID = PREM_DATE,
		ASM = MSUP,
		DETAIL = HDR,
		CSPI_ID = COUNT)) ~> DSTFFHEADER
